purpose: Non-sensitive customizations the default Supabase CLI schema dump excludes. Inventory only: not permission or executable restore SQL. Refresh from approved source metadata before actual export/restore.
target_status: blocked: an isolated managed recovery target and sensitive-data handling are not approved

storage_policies.with_check:
((bucket_id = 'question-images'::text) AND is_tutor() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM questions q
  WHERE (q.id = (split_part(objects.name, '/'::text, 1))::uuid))))

storage_policies.qual:
((bucket_id = 'question-images'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM questions q
  WHERE ((q.id = (split_part(objects.name, '/'::text, 1))::uuid) AND can_read_lesson(q.lesson_id)))))

((bucket_id = 'lesson-images'::text) AND is_tutor() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

  WHERE (l.id = (split_part(objects.name, '/'::text, 1))::uuid))))

((bucket_id = 'lesson-images'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

auth_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION create_profile()

public_dependency: public.create_profile() and all public application functions, owners/grants, constraints and two public attempt triggers must also restore from schema.sql.
separate_requirements: Actual Storage bytes with bucket/path/MIME/checksum manifest
Migration history schema/data if retention required
Auth/SMTP/URL/provider settings and any separate encrypted vault/extension material if actually used
Managed Auth/Storage schema/service version compatibility; do not import synthetic stubs into a real project

retained_server_read_only_metadata.scope: Read-only version/extension metadata only; no Vault data/key read.

extension_limitations: Installed supabase_vault is not evidence of actual Vault use; no secret values or encryption keys were inspected/exported. Target extension/schema compatibility and any actual encrypted-material recovery remain separately gated.
